findings.detail: Option E, marked correct, uses a style issue as a model review comment. The scenario aims to minimize false positives, and the guide says reviews should skip minor style issues and report bugs and security issues. An example that presents a style issue as a finding teaches the reviewer to report style issues, which contradicts the story.

blind_answer.reason: Detailed instructions alone are already producing inconsistent output, so the fix is few-shot examples, not more prose rules. Option A shows complete comments with location, issue, severity and suggested fix in the exact format. Option E uses 2–4 varied examples so the format holds across different kinds of findings. Batching (B) adds no consistency and doesn't suit blocking PR reviews. Longer rules (C) and vague exhortations (D) are what already isn't working.
